`enum NodeEffect.NodeEffectScope`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.effect` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeEffect.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/effect/NodeEffect.java)

What the shader passes of an effect process, the node alone or the node with its children.

## Description

[`NodeEffect.scope`](/reference/effects/nodeeffect/#NodeEffect-property-scope) takes it.
It changes the effects that work on pixels: rounded, circle, blur, border and the passes of your own effects.
A shadow, a mask, a transform and every `draw` of an effect always cover the children.

## Learn more

- [Effects](/use/learn/style-and-motion/effects/#round-a-node-with-its-children)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`SELF`](#NodeEffect-NodeEffectScope-value-SELF) | The passes process what the node draws itself; its children, its label and its layers draw on top, untouched. |
| [`CHILDREN`](#NodeEffect-NodeEffectScope-value-CHILDREN) | The passes process the node with its children and its layers, as one picture: rounded corners also cut the children that reach the edges. |
